Conde Redondo
Scroll

Upscale serviced residence in Lisbon, Portugal

Conversion of an office building into a high-end hotel residence comprising 34 apartments, managed by a well-established local operator.
Located near Lisbon’s main tourist attractions, Conde Redondo stands out with its 34 premium serviced apartments offering a wide range of amenities.

These apartments are designed to meet the growing demand from tourists as well as digital nomads seeking both comfort and convenience.
Project specifications
Status Under development
Total projected area 3 714 sq m
Estimated delivery S2 2027
Santo António, Lisbon
The location
The Santo António district offers a strategic location just a 15-minute walk from Lisbon’s historic Baixa. This proximity allows residents and visitors to enjoy the vibrant city center while benefiting from the calm and elegance of Santo António.

Currently undergoing dynamic development, this central neighborhood is attracting attention with its lively atmosphere, local shops, and modern amenities. Anchored by the iconic Avenida da Liberdade, Santo António blends tradition and modernity, making it one of Lisbon’s most promising and sought-after areas.

91 Champs‑Élysées

Acquisition of a mixed‑use building at 91 Champs‑Élysées in Paris, located on the most central stretch of the avenue. This exceptional 4,200 m² property enjoys unmatched visibility on the world’s most iconic thoroughfare, in the heart of the Golden Triangle, just steps away from the leading international luxury brands.

Mageva 360

Mageva 360 project is based on the acquisition of a historic chalet designed in 1961 by French architect Henry‑Jacques Le Même, formerly a holiday center. The project aims to transform this iconic building into a high‑end serviced residence with approximately 29 apartments, centered around the theme of “Wellness & Sport,” with a total surface area of 1,778 m².
